confirm.title: Yujian (discovered)
confirm.description: Discovered {name} on your network. Add this device to Home Assistant?

user.title: Yujian (manual)
user.description: Paste the call URL copied from the Yujian app to extract connection details, or enter them manually.

data_description.name: Device name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: The TV’s local IPv4 address; extracted automatically from a call URL.
data_description.port: Yujian HTTP service port; defaults to 8791.
data_description.token: Current access token from the TV app; extracted automatically from a call URL.
data_description.link: Paste the call URL copied from the app to extract the address, port, and token automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Yujian. Check the IP address, port, and token.
error.invalid_link: The URL does not contain an address or token. Copy the complete URL, such as http://192.168.1.5:8791/abc123/notify.
error.missing_fields: Paste a call URL, or enter both the IP address and token.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration is already in progress. Continue from discovered devices.
abort.no_token: The mDNS announcement does not include a token.
abort.not_supported_type: This is not a supported Yujian mDNS announcement.

init.title: Yujian settings
init.description: Adjust connection details and default duration. Optional HA TTS is used by speak: ha; speak: tv uses the TV speech engine.

data_description.name: Device name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: The TV’s current local IPv4 address.
data_description.port: Yujian HTTP service port; defaults to 8791.
data_description.token: Current access token from the TV app; update it if the token has been reset.
data_description.duration: Banner duration used when duration is omitted, from 1 to 30 seconds.
data_description.tts_entity: Used only by speak: ha. The TV must be able to fetch audio from Home Assistant.

notify.name: Send Yujian banner
notify.description: Send a banner with optional media. Without a target, sends to all configured Yujian devices.

message.name: Message
message.description: Optional body, up to four lines. Provide at least one of title, message, image, or video.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration from 1 to 30 seconds. Omit to use integration options.

level.name: Level
level.description: Notification severity: info, warn, or error.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.description: Keep visible until replaced, dismissed, or max_duration is reached.

max_duration.name: Maximum sticky duration
max_duration.description: Safety timeout from 30 to 3600 seconds; defaults to 300.

sound.name: Notification sound
sound.description: Play an entry sound. Device mute suppresses sound while keeping the banner visible.

image.name: Image
image.description: HTTP(S) image URL or inline base64 image. The TV must be able to fetch the URL.

video.name: MJPEG stream
video.description: MJPEG stream URL (multipart/x-mixed-replace). MP4 and other video files are not supported.

position.name: Position
position.description: Override this notification’s position. Omit to use the device default; corners use a small window.

speak.name: Speech
speak.description: off disables speech; ha uses configured HA TTS; tv uses TV speech. Legacy true means ha and false means off. Device mute suppresses speech.

queue.name: Queue
queue.description: Queue after the current banner instead of replacing it.

notify_id.name: Notification ID
notify_id.description: Reuse an ID to update the current banner and countdown without an entry animation.

image_interval.name: Image refresh interval
image_interval.description: Fetch the image URL again every 1 to 10 seconds. Applies only to images.

theme.name: Notification theme
theme.description: Override this notification’s theme. Omit to use the device default without changing global settings.

dismiss.name: Dismiss Yujian banner
dismiss.description: Close the current banner. Calling this when no banner is showing is also safe.

set_config.name: Configure Yujian device
set_config.description: Change mute, default position, or theme. Omitted settings are preserved. Mute suppresses sound and speech while keeping banners visible.

muted.name: Notification mute
muted.description: Suppress sounds and speech while keeping banners visible.

theme.name: Default theme
theme.description: Default theme for notifications that omit theme.

position.name: Default position
position.description: Default position for notifications that omit position.
